Bow to the Balcony

You finish the exchange with a sweeping bow, already slipping beyond their reach.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Guile

Target / range / shape: One adjacent creature.

Make a melee attack, then end the exchange with a flourish. After the damage, move up to 3 squares without provoking along a legal route.

- Weak: 4 physical damage. - Standard: 5 physical damage; the target is pushed 1 square away before you move. - Strong: 7 physical damage; push it 2 before moving.

Duration: Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.

Equipment / acquisition: Use one ordinary melee weapon; gain one on learning this card if you do not own one. Bulk 1.

---

Tier / minimum level: 7 · DP: 8 · Requirements to learn: Arms 3

Type: Skill / Attack

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

ID: bow-to-the-balcony
